## Schedule accompanying a small claim

Claim No: ⟦CASE|Q7ZX/8421/26⟧

The claimant ⟦PERSON|Vesper Drenwick⟧ claims repayment of a deposit from ⟦ORG|Moth Lantern Events Ltd⟧. The booking was for an indoor equipment demonstration. When the venue became unavailable, the defendant offered an outdoor space without weather protection. The claimant rejected that alternative promptly and requested the deposit back.

| Event | Date | Amount |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Deposit received | 8 June 2026 | GBP 375 |
| Venue withdrawn | 19 July 2026 | GBP 0 |
| Repayment requested | 20 July 2026 | GBP 375 |

The defendant's cancellation term applies when the customer cancels an available booking. It does not expressly permit retention when the defendant cannot provide the booked venue. The claimant asks the court to construe that term in its contractual context.

**Witness:** ⟦PERSON|A. Q. Ternell⟧, who attended the inspection. **Telephone:** ⟦PHONE|+44 7700 90O842⟧. One character on the copied contact sheet is unclear; it has been preserved rather than guessed.

The witness can explain why the alternative venue could not safely accommodate the demonstration. The claimant does not claim a travel allowance or lost earnings. The claimant relies on section 5.1 of the booking conditions and article 6 of the procedural schedule.

Signed: ⟦PERSON|Vesper Drenwick⟧. Filing date: 3 November 2026.
